stem.text: A farmer is trying to lift the corner of a large water tank. She uses a metal rod as a lever.

stem.alt: Lever diagram: a rod resting on a pivot, with a water tank at one end and a downward arrow labelled force from farmer at the other end; labels water tank, metal rod and pivot.

stem.text: The vertical force from the farmer is constant and is always applied to the end of the rod.
Which change **must** increase the upward force on the water tank?

A.text: using a longer rod and moving the pivot closer to the tank

B.text: using a longer rod and moving the pivot further away from the tank

C.text: using a shorter rod and moving the pivot closer to the tank

D.text: using a shorter rod and moving the pivot further away from the tank
